div.div:
Signed-in report about accessible event.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
reporter_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
category: text [NN]
description: text [NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'open'
resolved_by_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
resolution: text [?]
resolved_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
CK1: status IN ('open','reviewing','resolved')
CK2: status <> 'resolved' OR (resolved_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL
AND resolution IS NOT NULL)
PARTIAL UQ: (event_id, reporter_user_id, category) WHERE status IN ('open','reviewing')
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id) -> event(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(reporter_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(resolved_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Append-only moderation evidence; exactly one real target.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
actor_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
target_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
target_event_id: uuid [FK ?]
target_activation_id: uuid [FK ?]
action: text [NN]
reason: text [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
CK1: num_nonnulls(target_user_id,target_event_id,target_activation_id) = 1
CK2: action IN ('suspend','reinstate')
CK3: length(btrim(reason)) > 0
TRIGGER: reject UPDATE / DELETE (append-only).
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(target_event_id) -> event(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(target_activation_id) -> sales_activation(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(actor_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(target_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Append-only versioned settings; current version selected by effective time/version.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
setting_key: text [NN]
version: integer [NN]
value: jsonb [NN]
effective_at: timestamptz [NN]
actor_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (setting_key, version)
CK1: version > 0
TRIGGER: reject UPDATE / DELETE (append-only).
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(actor_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Deduplicated allowlisted optional traffic/commerce measurement.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
connection_id: uuid [FK NN]
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
order_id: uuid [FK ?]
refund_id: uuid [FK ?]
measurement_kind: text [NN]
analytics_event_id: uuid [UQ NN]
safe_payload: jsonb [NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'pending'
sent_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (analytics_event_id)
UQ2: (connection_id, order_id, measurement_kind)
UQ3: (connection_id, refund_id, measurement_kind)
CK1: status IN ('pending','sent','skipped','failed')
CK2: jsonb_typeof(safe_payload) = 'object'
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(connection_id) -> ga4_connection(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(order_id, event_id) -> ticket_order(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(refund_id, event_id) -> refund(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Disposable event-scoped traffic aggregates; never financial truth.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
connection_id: uuid [FK NN]
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
query_hash: text [NN]
range_start: date [NN]
range_end: date [NN]
metrics: jsonb [NN]
fetched_at: timestamptz [NN]
expires_at: timestamptz [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (connection_id, event_id, query_hash)
CK1: range_end > range_start
CK2: expires_at > fetched_at
CK3: jsonb_typeof(metrics) = 'object'
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(connection_id) -> ga4_connection(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(event_id) -> event(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
